# hetzner_server_name (Resource)

Manages only the name of an existing dedicated server, for servers whose order and cancellation live outside Terraform. Destroying it removes it from state and leaves the server and its name untouched; use `hetzner_server_order` to manage the server's lifecycle.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Sets the Robot name of an existing server. Destroying it leaves the server untouched.
resource "hetzner_server_name" "example" {
  server_number = 12345
  server_name   = "my-server"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `server_name` (String) The server name shown in Robot.
- `server_number` (Number) The server number.
